Positions are copied from the source paper and are integers as printed. Bischoff et al. give the band frequency (upper value) and 'halfwidth' (lower value) in Table 1; halfwidth_cm1 is that printed value (older papers usually mean the full width at half maximum by 'halfwidth').
Literature spread over this project's calcite papers (Qiaomu/peaks/calcite_peaks.csv) is a few cm-1 per mode; Mg substitution shifts every band upward.
